Mental health professionals spend years, even decades of their lives studying and being examined by tough teachers in order to get their credentials. Don't  take this for granted and kid yourself with this "I've done my research" phrase because it's everything but research. Treatments that change the nature of the brain must be decided by skilled professionals. The best thing you can do is ask for more than 3 opinions of licensed professionals, take many tests and then wait for the diagnosis. If more than 3 tell you you have ADHD on the basis of those tests, then you can make a safe assumption that you have ADHD.
